title: 文化介绍中的动词搭配
goal: 能理解文化介绍中的动词搭配，并在译句中准确使用。

points.label: 识别介绍事物的动词搭配
在译句中使用符合原意的搭配

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 翻译教学所依据的大纲

body.p: 介绍文化事物时，常用动词搭配说明起源、用途、影响和保护。选词要符合原文的对象和关系。

body.box:
原文：这项传统可以追溯到十九世纪。
译文：The tradition dates back to the nineteenth century.

body.p: date back to 引出起始时间，后接年代或时期。

cards.title: 词汇表：起源
rows: The tradition dates back to the nineteenth century.
The craft originated in the region.
The market began as a small gathering.
The festival developed from a local custom.
The event grew out of a village fair.
A new style emerged from these exchanges.
The collection was established by local teachers.
The design is based on a traditional pattern.
The name derives from an old word.

cards.title: 词汇表：用途
rows: The room is used for exhibitions.
The basket is used to carry fruit.
The hall serves as a meeting place.
The garden provides space for classes.
The path provides access to the hall.
The center offers a place for meetings.
The table is designed for group work.
The bags were made for visitors.
The guide is intended for new visitors.

cards.title: 词汇表：影响
rows: The market plays a role in community life.
The visits contribute to cultural exchange.
The design has an effect on airflow.
The program creates opportunities for artists.

items.stem: 原文：这个习俗可以追溯到十九世纪。Which translation expresses the origin?
options: The custom dates back to the nineteenth century.
The custom developed in the twentieth century.
The custom originated in the eighteenth century.
The custom ended in the nineteenth century.
items.why: 「追溯到十九世纪」用 dates back to the nineteenth century，即第一项。第三项的世纪不对。

items.stem: 原文：这间大厅用作社区的会议场所。Which phrase expresses the function?
options: began as a community meeting place
serves as a community meeting place
protects a community meeting place
develops from a community meeting place
items.why: 「用作」某种场所用 serve as，即第二项。第一项 began as 是「最初作为」。

items.stem: 原文：这个集市在社区生活中发挥作用。Which phrase preserves the relationship?
options: dates back to community life
is based on the history of community life
plays a role in community life
documents community life
items.why: 「在……中发挥作用」用 play a role in，即第三项。

items.stem: 原文：工匠向年轻人传授传统技艺。Which phrase describes the action?
options: preserve traditions for young people
record traditional techniques with young people
document the craft for young people
pass on traditional skills to young people
items.why: 「传授技艺」用 pass on skills，即第四项。第二项的 record 是记录，不是传授。

groups.text: 原文：这个展室用作会议场所。志愿者记录传统技艺，工匠向年轻人传授这些技艺。活动促进文化交流。

items.stem: Which phrase describes the function of the room?
options: serves as a meeting place
began as a meeting place
protects a meeting place
provides access to meetings
items.why: 「用作会议场所」用 serves as a meeting place，即第一项。

options: pass on techniques
document techniques
preserve old traditions
promote techniques
items.why: 「记录技艺」用 document techniques，即第二项。第一项 pass on 是传授。

items.stem: Which phrase expresses the effect of the event?
options: documents cultural exchange
grows out of cultural exchange
contributes to cultural exchange
is based on an earlier cultural exchange

groups.fill: A small gallery opened in the town. Its design is ba{sed} on an older workshop, and its rooms are us{ed} for exhibitions. The path provides acc{ess} to the entrance. Local artists pl{ay} a role in the program and att{ract} visitors with their work. The staff rec{ord} techniques and docu{ment} the craft. They also pres{erve} traditions, pro{tect} objects and pre{vent} damage. These activities connect the collection with the people who make and use the objects.

items.stem: 原文：这座展馆可以追溯到二十世纪。Which translation expresses the origin?
options: The gallery dates back to the twentieth century.
The gallery opened in the twenty-first century.
The gallery originated in the nineteenth century.
The gallery closed in the twentieth century.
items.why: 「追溯到二十世纪」用 dates back to the twentieth century，即第一项。第三项的世纪不对。

items.stem: 原文：这条小路通向附近的展览大厅。Which phrase expresses access?
options: preserves the nearby exhibition hall
provides access to the nearby exhibition hall
dates back to the nearby exhibition hall
is designed for the nearby exhibition hall
items.why: 「通向」某处用 provide access to，即第二项。

items.stem: 原文：这一活动促进了地区之间的文化交流。Which phrase preserves the relationship?
options: documented cultural exchange between regions
was based on an earlier cultural exchange between regions
contributed to cultural exchange between regions
grew out of cultural exchange between regions
items.why: 「促进了」用 contributed to，「地区之间」译作 between regions，即第三项。

items.stem: 原文：工作人员修复了这座旧建筑。Which phrase describes their action?
options: maintained the old building
documented the old building
used the old building
restored the old building
items.why: 「修复」建筑用 restore，即第四项。第一项 maintain 是日常维护，不是修复。

items.stem: 原文：展览吸引了来自附近地区的访客。Which phrase expresses the effect?
options: attracted visitors from nearby areas
brought visitors to nearby areas
attracted visitors to nearby areas
supported local businesses in nearby areas
items.why: 「吸引了来自附近地区的访客」用 attracted visitors from nearby areas，即第一项。第三项把方向说反了。

items.stem: 原文：工匠将技艺传授给了年轻的学徒。Which phrase describes the action?
options: recorded the skills of young apprentices
passed on skills to young apprentices
learned skills from their young apprentices
praised young apprentices' skills
items.why: 「传授给」用 pass on ... to，即第二项。第三项把传授的方向说反了。
